purpose: B01/#1046, N16/#1348 and N18A/#1367: permitted module edges, exported ports, external-crate ports and Cargo feature configuration of the native desktop crate (src-tauri), enforced through the normal local boundaries lane by the Rust-aware analyzer (scripts/nemo/lib/boundaries-rust.cjs). Module identity and layers come from rust.profile.json; this policy pins the application_mcp.rs <-> nemo-mcp transport port plus module-local Tauri-host <-> native-engine ports for the dormant bootstrap, commands, tests, viewport, concrete ports and dispatch seam.
profileModulesNote: The fifteen profile modules under sourceDir. rust.desktop.build (src-tauri/build.rs) is outside sourceDir (dir 'src-tauri', not 'src-tauri/src') and is not part of this crate's own module graph; it is named in unanalyzedModules below as a census entry only.

desktop-shell.meaning: lib.rs/main.rs (shell), media_probe.rs/vectorize.rs/video_decode.rs (media) and task_runtime.rs (tasks) may depend on each other and declare the dormant host modules, never directly on tests

mcp-adapter.meaning: application_mcp.rs owns transport and may depend on the shared boxed native-dispatch seam, but not on bootstrap or sibling presentation/resource adapters

viewport-adapter.meaning: native_viewport.rs is the platform surface adapter and does not reach the bootstrap, transport, contract or host ports

host-ports.meaning: native_application_ports.rs owns concrete resource, artifact and shared-compositor ports without reaching host orchestration

host-contract.meaning: native_application_contract.rs validates versioned requests and admitted resources through the concrete resource resolver without reaching transport, bootstrap or presentation owners

viewport-owner.meaning: native_application_viewport.rs retains the main-thread viewport and uses only the strict host contract plus platform viewport adapter

bootstrap.meaning: native_application.rs and native_application_release.rs own the dormant application core and terminal release lifecycle through the strict contract, concrete ports and shared dispatch seam; command and presentation concerns live in their own modules

command-adapter.meaning: native_application_commands.rs is the dormant Tauri command surface and composes existing owners without becoming another state authority

host-seam.meaning: native_dispatch.rs owns the shared boxed application seam and export pump. It is depended on by owners, but does not reach back into the MCP adapter, application bootstrap or viewport.

tests.meaning: Focused tests may reach their declared owners but not the shared host-seam directly: task-runtime, MCP, application and concrete-port tests each name the production module they exercise

permittedEdges.note: Observed at adoption from `mod …;` declarations in lib.rs (the crate root) and `use super::*;` in task_runtime/tests.rs (analyzer output). Layer rules are the enforced contract; this list documents which edges exist so a new one is a visible diff. Plain function-call references such as `video_decode::VideoSessions::default()` in lib.rs are unqualified sibling-module paths, not `crate::`/`super::`/`self::` paths, so they are outside what this analyzer resolves and add no edges beyond the `mod …;` declarations already listed.
edges: rust.desktop.shell -> rust.desktop.media (lib.rs: mod video_decode; mod media_probe; mod vectorize;)

exportedPort.source: src-tauri/src/lib.rs has no `pub use` re-exports; the Tauri command functions registered via `tauri::generate_handler![...]` are Tauri's own invoke registration, not a Rust module export

features.declaredNote: src-tauri/Cargo.toml has no [features] table; any cfg(feature = "…") in the crate would therefore reference an undeclared feature and fail. The crate uses no feature cfgs today, only the four plain predicates below.

nemo_mcp.note: The versioned nemo-mcp transport port (rust.mcp.transport, nemo-mcp/src/lib.rs publicApi) consumed by application_mcp.rs and the dormant native host contract, commands and focused tests. This legacy form shares one item list across its named modules; a declared item covers itself and deeper paths (for example, registry covers registry::Endpoint). Every other module is denied, and an undeclared nemo_mcp path is a private-port-access violation.

native_engine.note: The narrow native-engine host port is declared per exact desktop profile module, so bootstrap, focused tests, surface presentation and concrete resource/artifact/compositor ports cannot borrow each other's native-engine privileges. An omitted module is denied. The common nemo-mcp transport crate remains independent of native-engine and keeps the legacy shared allowlist form.

unanalyzedModulesNote: Census entries only, never graphed by this analyzer: rust.desktop.build is the Cargo build script outside sourceDir; rust.mcp.transport and rust.native.engine are separate crates referenced only as targets of the declared external-crate ports and are not given intra-crate policies by this file.
